label: DisasterReady India - Relief Supplies & Request Tracking
title: DisasterReady India - Relief Supplies & Request Tracking
prompt:
DisasterReady India Relief Supplies Request & Live Citizen Tracking Portal.
Key elements:
1. 7-Step Relief Request Flow (/supplies/1 to /supplies/done):
- Step 1: "What do you need?" multi-select 56px tiles with Lucide-style 2px stroke line SVGs: Drinking water, Food packets, Medicine kits, Blankets, Tents, Baby food, Sanitation kits. "I am helping another person" and "Assisted entry (helpline operator)" modes.
- Step 2: "How many people?" large accessible stepper, plus extra care tiles (Infant, Elderly, Pregnant, Disabled, Patient) each with individual count steppers.
- Step 3: "How long without supplies?" (<6h, 6-24h, 1-2d, >2d).
- Step 4: "Where are you?" (Use location, landmark picker with Mohanpur, Bhadrapur, Kharadi, Gandhi Chowk, or map pin).
- Step 5: Phone number (10-digit validation) with clear DPDP explanation.
- Step 6: Review & Duplicate detection notice (inline check for nearby existing requests in same ward).
- Step 7: Confirmation with large token DR-1042, plain-language timeline status, QR code display (deterministic SVG), and download confirmation receipt.
2. Live Request Tracker (/track/DR-1042):
- Search by Request Number + Phone.
- Seeded DR-1042 live tracking view: Timeline stages (Received -> Checked -> Assigned -> On the way -> Delivered).
- Per-item breakdown: Water (6 of 10 delivered, 4 short - Stock shortage reason), Food (5 of 5 delivered - Fulfilled), Medicine (0 of 2 - Route blocked).
- Delivery confirmation 4-digit code (4829) with QR verification box and courier verification workflow.
- Plain-language SMS text fallback builder (DRI#SOS#format).
- Full speech synthesis read-aloud support.
